answer_1.quote: We augment the deepest layer of the hierarchy by generating terms that are connected as children of the existing leaves ... We prompt an LLM to generate ↓c_{L j} starting from a context that we extract from the hierarchy itself.

answer_2.quote: Results are measured in terms of macro-F1 score. ... We define two metrics grounded in cosine similarity to gauge the evolving average proximity among nodes ... Metric D1 is defined as the average cosine similarity among the node's children embeddings. Metric D2 is defined as the average similarity between a parent node and its children.
